quote: A vehicle shall not be driven in a designated two-way left-turn lane except when preparing for or making a left turn. A left turn shall not be made from any other lane where a two-way left-turn lane has been designated.

activation.condition: A vehicle occupies a lane that may be a designated two-way left-turn lane.

obligation.description: Do not drive in a designated two-way left-turn lane except when preparing for or making a left turn; make a left turn from that lane when one has been designated.

exceptions.source_clause: except when preparing for or making a left turn
exceptions.description: Driving in the designated lane for left-turn preparation or execution is expressly excepted; designation and preparation require original facts.

timing.description: Observe lane entry, intended turn preparation, lane of origin and turn or straight trajectory through the maneuver.

judgment_calls_needed.note: Native lane topology and markings are candidates; original municipal designation authority and applicable scope need review.

judgment_calls_needed.phrase: preparing for or making a left turn
judgment_calls_needed.note: Authored target/actor/time intent and original heading/route observations need independent review; an indicator alone is insufficient.

parameter_refs.name: origin_lane
parameter_refs.range_or_domain: Selected center candidate or adjacent outer lane

parameter_refs.name: maneuver
parameter_refs.range_or_domain: Authored left turn or straight route

parameter_refs.name: designation_authority
parameter_refs.range_or_domain: Null until original lane designation and authority are reviewed
